Package org.apache.wiki.auth

Class AccountLifecycle

java.lang.Object
org.apache.wiki.auth.AccountLifecycle
public final class AccountLifecycle extends Object
What happens to a user account as the password of its owner gets older, on top of PasswordExpiry. Each stage is optional and is counted in days from the last time the password was changed (UserProfile.getPasswordChanged()):
  • "jspwiki.credentials.expiry.warnDays": the owner is told that the password is going to expire. Only if "jspwiki.credentials.expiry.days" is set, and later than this.
  • "jspwiki.credentials.lock.days": the account is locked, and its owner told. It stays locked until an administrator unlocks it.
  • "jspwiki.credentials.delete.days": the account is deleted, and its owner told.
A stage has to come after the ones before it, in the order of the list and of the expiry of the password; if it does not, it is logged and the stage is off. apply(Date) goes through all the accounts once. The password that has no date yet gets it, which is when its clock starts.
Since:
3.0.1
